body_lead: CHENNAI: R Kirlosh Kumar, principal secretary of Housing and Urban Development, announced that Single Platform for Efficient Expedited Development (SPEED), an AI-based planning approval software, is expected to be rolled out in six to seven months. The new system, announced earlier by the TVK government, is intended to address delays in the existing approval process. "The government would begin onboarding a service provider in October," Kirlosh Kumar said during a panel discussion on ease of doing business in real estate at CREDAI Tamil Nadu Statecon 2026.
